summary: Answer strict exact-Submittal Spec Section, Description and Review Comments requests from explicit labelled local evidence.
decision_refs: The active objective requires faster and more accurate file-grounded Q&A across RFI, Submittal and Email
Submittal evidence already has exact workflow scope but not dedicated field locators
Explicit labels provide a deterministic field boundary without changing the parser or adding a model call
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements to the existing file-grounded question flow.
known_limitations: Only strict English Spec Section, Description and Review Comments requests naming one exact Submittal use the shortcut.
Only explicit supported labels inside an exact Submittal scope qualify; unlabeled nearby text falls through.
Multiple primary sources, conflicting values, quoted Email history, vision narration and more than 32 candidate passages fail closed.
The shortcut does not infer Description from Subject, infer a Spec Section from a nearby number, choose a revision or decide controlling authority.
